extras: Provides a visual panel interface to avoid writing CSS.
intentEvidence: Simply put: Professional manuscript effects without writing a single line of CSS.
motivation: The author built it to provide professional manuscript effects without requiring users to write or understand CSS code.
problem: Users find white editors visually tiring, and traditional CSS snippets require technical knowledge to achieve professional manuscript effects.
summary: PaperCraft is a customizable manuscript paper plugin that applies traditional paper styles, textures, and typography to notes using an intuitive visual editor instead of CSS.
